newsitem.title: JAPAN: Canon to end camcorder OEM deal with Matsushita.
newsitem.headline: Canon to end camcorder OEM deal with Matsushita.

text.p: Canon Inc said on Wednesday that it plans to end an OEM (original equipment manufacturer) agreement with Matsushita Electric Industrial Co Ltd on digital video cameras by the end of this year and to begin making the products on its own.

Canon will install a chip it has recently developed, which combines recording and playback signal processing circuits into a single large-scale integrated circuit, in its digital camcorders, a company spokesman said.
The new chip allows multiple signal processing functions such as image reduction and expansion.
A spokesman for Matsushita Electric Industrial said the amount of camcorders produced for Canon was relatively small and the impact on it of ending the OEM agreement would be negligible.
